This occurs when the system updates form submission statistics with new submission counts and unread submission deltas. Includes form ID, universal delta, and unread delta for tracking submission count updates, monitoring form submission statistics, and ensuring proper submission count management and delta tracking across different form types and submission scenarios.

Logs when form authentication provider settings are being updated to record authentication configuration changes and provider updates. This occurs when users modify form authentication settings, change authentication providers, or update authentication configuration options. Includes form ID and authentication provider details for tracking authentication setting updates, monitoring form security configuration changes, and ensuring proper form authentication management and provider configuration across different authentication types and form scenarios.

messages.message: Updating SAML settings manually for Form Authentication provider
messages.aiComments: Logs when SAML authentication settings are manually updated for form authentication providers to record SAML configuration changes and manual updates. This occurs when users manually modify SAML authentication settings, update SAML metadata, or change SAML configuration options for form authentication. Includes form ID and SAML provider details for tracking SAML setting updates, monitoring form authentication configuration changes, and ensuring proper SAML authentication management and manual configuration updates across different SAML providers and form scenarios.

messages.message: Uploading SAML metadata file for Form Authentication provider
messages.aiComments: Logs when SAML metadata files are uploaded for form authentication providers to record SAML metadata upload events and file processing. This occurs when users upload SAML metadata files to configure form authentication providers and the system processes the uploaded metadata. Includes form ID and SAML metadata details for tracking SAML metadata uploads, monitoring form authentication configuration, and ensuring proper SAML metadata management and file upload processing across different SAML providers and form scenarios.

Logs when users change field types in form builder to record field type modification events and form structure changes. This occurs when users modify form fields by changing their types (e.g., from text to dropdown, from single line to multi-line) and the system records the field type change. Includes form ID, field ID, and field type details for tracking field type changes, monitoring form structure modifications, and ensuring proper field type management and form builder audit trails across different field types and form scenarios.

Logs when email HTML processing uses cached processed HTML instead of regenerating it. This occurs when the email system finds previously processed HTML with CSS inlined and reuses it for performance. Includes cache hit information to track email processing efficiency and reduce computational overhead for frequently sent email templates.

messages.message: Using single-part S3 upload for small file
messages.aiComments: Logs when S3 file uploads use single-part upload method for small files to record S3 upload strategy and performance optimization. This occurs when the system uploads small files to Amazon S3 using the simpler single-part upload method instead of multipart uploads. Includes S3 upload details for tracking S3 upload performance, monitoring file upload strategies, and ensuring proper S3 upload optimization and cost efficiency across different file sizes and upload scenarios.

Logs reCAPTCHA verification results to record CAPTCHA validation outcomes and bot detection events. This occurs when form submissions are validated against Google reCAPTCHA to prevent spam and bot submissions. Includes reCAPTCHA score and verification details for tracking CAPTCHA effectiveness, monitoring bot detection accuracy, and ensuring proper form security and spam prevention across different form submissions and CAPTCHA versions.

Logs when users view temporary unsanitized submission data to record access to raw submission data before sanitization processing. This occurs when administrators or support staff access temporary unsanitized data for debugging or data recovery purposes. Includes submission ID and user details for tracking raw data access, monitoring data security compliance, and ensuring proper audit trails for sensitive data access across different submission types and access scenarios.

Logs successful virus scan completion via ClamAV during file upload processing. This occurs when uploaded files pass security scanning to ensure they are safe before storage. Includes scan duration and ClamAV response details for monitoring file security compliance and tracking virus scanning performance across the platform.

Logs webhook pre-send preparation phase to record webhook request preparation and data processing before sending. This occurs when the system prepares webhook payloads and validates webhook configurations before sending webhook notifications to external endpoints. Includes webhook details for tracking webhook preparation steps, monitoring webhook processing performance, and ensuring proper webhook data preparation and validation across different webhook configurations and submission scenarios.

Logs when webhooks are queued for submission processing to record webhook queue operations and asynchronous webhook delivery. This occurs when form submissions trigger webhook notifications that are added to the queue for asynchronous processing. Includes submission ID and webhook details for tracking webhook queue operations, monitoring webhook delivery scheduling, and ensuring proper webhook processing and delivery across different submission types and webhook configurations.

Logs webhook delivery failures to record webhook send errors and external integration issues. This occurs when webhook notifications fail to deliver to external endpoints due to network errors, timeout issues, or endpoint unavailability. Includes webhook error details for tracking webhook delivery failures, monitoring external integration health, and ensuring proper webhook retry logic and error handling across different webhook configurations and submission scenarios.

Logs successful webhook delivery to external endpoints during submit action processing. This occurs when form submissions trigger webhook notifications to configured external URLs. Includes webhook details for tracking webhook delivery success rates, monitoring external integration health, and ensuring proper webhook notification delivery across different submit action configurations.

Logs API calls to WebMerge document generation service to record WebMerge integration operations and document creation events. This occurs when form submissions trigger WebMerge submit actions to generate PDF documents, contracts, or other merged documents. Includes API call details for tracking WebMerge integration usage, monitoring document generation performance, and ensuring proper WebMerge API connectivity and document creation across different form submissions and document templates.

Logs when workflow submissions are successfully updated to record workflow update events and submission processing completion. This occurs when workflow processes complete successfully and update submission data or workflow status. Includes submission ID and workflow details for tracking workflow updates, monitoring submission workflow progression, and ensuring proper workflow management and update tracking across different workflow types and submission scenarios.

messages.message: XML after purifying has changed in SAMLAuthProvider
messages.aiComments: Logs when SAML XML metadata changes after purification processing to record SAML metadata modification events and XML processing changes. This occurs when SAML metadata XML is processed and purified, resulting in changes to the XML structure or content. Includes SAML provider details and XML change information for tracking SAML metadata modifications, monitoring XML processing changes, and ensuring proper SAML metadata management and XML purification tracking across different SAML providers and metadata scenarios.
